name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana
description: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) is a flagship Government of India scheme facilitating micro credit or loans up to ₹20 lakh to income-generating micro enterprises in the non-farm sector, including manufacturing, trading, services and activities allied to agriculture such as poultry, dairy and beekeeping. Loans are provided through eligible Member Lending Institutions including public sector banks, private sector banks, state-operated cooperative banks, regional rural banks, MFIs, NBFCs, small finance banks and other approved financial intermediaries.
benefits: Shishu loans covering loans up to ₹50,000.
Kishore loans above ₹50,000 and up to ₹5 lakh.
Tarun loans above ₹5 lakh and up to ₹10 lakh.
Tarun Plus loans up to ₹20 lakh for entrepreneurs who have successfully repaid previous loans under the Tarun category.
Interest rates are determined by Member Lending Institutions according to applicable RBI guidelines.
Upfront fee or processing charges for Shishu loans are waived by most banks according to the supplied source.

rules.description: Eligible borrowers listed in the source include individuals, proprietary concerns, partnership firms, private limited companies, public companies and other legal forms.

The proposed activity must be an income-generating micro enterprise in the non-farm sector, including manufacturing, trading, services or activities allied to agriculture such as poultry, dairy and beekeeping.
The applicant should not be a defaulter to any bank or financial institution and should have a satisfactory credit track record.

exclusion_rules.description: Applicant should not be a defaulter to any bank or financial institution.

documents.description: Proof of identity. Required for Shishu, Kishore, Tarun and Tarun Plus loan categories.
Proof of residence. Required for Shishu, Kishore, Tarun and Tarun Plus loan categories.
Recent coloured photograph of the applicant. Required for Shishu, Kishore, Tarun and Tarun Plus loan categories.

documents.document_name: Quotation of machinery or other items to be purchased
documents.description: Quotation of machinery or other items to be purchased. Required for Shishu loan category.

documents.document_name: Supplier name, details of machinery and price
documents.description: Supplier name, details of machinery and price of machinery or items. Required for Shishu loan category.

documents.document_name: Proof of Identity or Address of Business Enterprise
documents.description: Proof of identity or address of business enterprise. Required for Shishu, Kishore, Tarun and Tarun Plus loan categories.

documents.document_name: Bank or financial institution non-default status certificate
documents.description: Bank or financial institution certificate confirming non-default status. Required for Kishore, Tarun and Tarun Plus loan categories.

documents.document_name: Statement of accounts for the last six months
documents.description: Statement of accounts for the last six months, where an existing banker is involved. Required for Kishore, Tarun and Tarun Plus loan categories where an existing banker is involved.

documents.document_name: Last two years balance sheets with income tax or sales tax returns
documents.description: Last two years balance sheets with income tax or sales tax returns. Applicable for cases from ₹2 lakh and above in Kishore, Tarun and Tarun Plus loan categories.
Projected balance sheets. Applicable for relevant working-capital or term-loan cases in Kishore, Tarun and Tarun Plus loan categories.

documents.document_name: Sales achieved during the current financial year
documents.description: Sales achieved during the current financial year up to the application date. Required for Kishore, Tarun and Tarun Plus loan categories.

documents.document_name: Project report containing technical and economic viability
documents.description: Project report containing technical and economic viability. Required for Kishore, Tarun and Tarun Plus loan categories.

documents.document_name: Memorandum and Articles of Association or Partnership Deed
documents.description: Memorandum and Articles of Association or Partnership Deed as applicable. Required for Kishore, Tarun and Tarun Plus loan categories where applicable.
Asset and Liability statement where third-party guarantee is absent and required to assess net worth. Required for Kishore, Tarun and Tarun Plus loan categories where applicable.

tutorial_steps.title: Visit the official PM MUDRA website
tutorial_steps.description: Visit the official PM MUDRA website at https://www.mudra.org.in/.

tutorial_steps.title: Select the Udyamimitra portal
tutorial_steps.description: Select the Udyamimitra portal at https://udyamimitra.in/.

tutorial_steps.title: Click Mudra loan and Apply Now
Select entrepreneur type
tutorial_steps.description: Select one of: New entrepreneur, Existing Entrepreneur, or Self-employed professional.

tutorial_steps.title: Enter applicant details and verify OTP
tutorial_steps.description: Enter applicant name, email and mobile number and generate OTP.

tutorial_steps.title: Fill personal and professional details
tutorial_steps.description: After successful registration, fill personal details and professional details.

tutorial_steps.title: Select hand-holding agency or Loan Application Center
tutorial_steps.description: Select a hand-holding agency if help is required for preparing project proposals; otherwise select 'Loan Application Center'.

tutorial_steps.title: Select the required loan category
tutorial_steps.description: Select the required loan category: Mudra Shishu, Mudra Kishore, or Mudra Tarun.

tutorial_steps.title: Fill business information
tutorial_steps.description: Fill business information including business name and business activity.

tutorial_steps.title: Select the industry type
tutorial_steps.description: Select the industry type: Manufacturing, Service, Trading, or Activities allied to agriculture.

tutorial_steps.title: Fill owner and financial details
tutorial_steps.description: Fill owner details, existing banking and credit facilities, proposed credit facilities, future estimates and preferred lender.

tutorial_steps.title: Attach the required documents
tutorial_steps.description: Attach the required documents based on the selected loan category.

tutorial_steps.title: Save the Application Number
tutorial_steps.description: Save the generated Application Number for future reference.
